newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see some EU action.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see some EU action.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some action in EU rapemeal this afternoon as dealers covered on the feeling the market could firm further on weather in the U.S. Midwest, market sources said.

"We saw trade in EU rapemeal from August to Jan next year as rapemeal is relatively cheap and could rise soon following soymeal futures in Chicago which were expected higher on hot and dry weather," one broker said.
Chicago futures opened higher but eased shortly after on long term forecasts for rain in the U.S. Midwest.
Otherwise only a few nearby trades were reported as a strong dollar and firmer seller prices kept most buyers sidelined.
Aug EU rapemeal changed hands at 22.50 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine, Sept at 23.25, Oct at 24 and Nov/Jan at 25.50 marks fob Lower Rhine.
Arrived Brazilian soymeal pellets fetched $278 a tonne cif Rotterdam and arrived Thai tapioca changed hands at 17.40 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
